# bob notebooks

Inspect or maintain notebook notes

```text title="bob notebooks --help"
Inspect or maintain notebook notes

Bare `bob notebooks` runs the read-only list. `list` shows the tree grouped by root. `check` lints notebooks against the contract.

Usage: bob notebooks [COMMAND]

Commands:
  check  Check notebooks against the contract
  list   List notebooks grouped by root (default)

Options:
  -h, --help  Print help

Bare `bob notebooks` runs the read-only list.

Examples:
  bob notebooks                       List notebooks grouped by root
  bob notebooks list -r dev           List one root's notebooks
  bob notebooks check                 Lint notebooks against the contract
  bob notebooks check -f json         Findings as JSON

See docs/notebooks.md for the notebook contract.
Run 'bob notebooks <command> --help' for more information on a command.
```

## bob notebooks check

Check notebooks against the contract

```text title="bob notebooks check --help"
Findings grouped by notebook, plus a notebook/root/error/warning summary. Exits 1 on any error, 0 otherwise. This command is read-only.

Usage: bob notebooks check [OPTIONS]

Options:
  -b, --bob-dir <DIR>
          Bob vault root; defaults to BOB_DIR or ~/bob

  -f, --format <FORMAT>
          Output format: human or json

          [default: human]
          [possible values: human, json]

  -h, --help
          Show help

Examples:
  bob notebooks check
  bob notebooks check -f json
```

## bob notebooks list

List notebooks grouped by root (default)

```text title="bob notebooks list --help"
Tree of notebooks grouped by root, with titles, summaries, counts, and issue markers. This command is read-only. Bare `bob notebooks` runs this command.

Usage: bob notebooks list [OPTIONS]

Options:
  -b, --bob-dir <DIR>
          Bob vault root; defaults to BOB_DIR or ~/bob

  -f, --format <FORMAT>
          Output format: human or json

          [default: human]
          [possible values: human, json]

  -h, --help
          Show help

  -r, --root <ROOT>
          Filter to one computed root identity

Examples:
  bob notebooks
  bob notebooks list
  bob notebooks list -r dev -f json
```
